scope: new S1 extraction questions; not reconstruction of the lost original S0 questions
questions: Classify the visible image domain: traditional painting reproduction, modern illustration, cover/poster, photograph, or uncertain/mixed. Give visible reasons. Do not infer authorship or date.
Describe only visible subjects, positions and counts. Assign V1, V2 and other evidence IDs. Treat music associations as interpretations, not objects in the image.
Describe composition, empty space, density, layering and visible ink/color contrasts. Reuse evidence IDs and mark ambiguity.
Describe supported directional gestures, repetition and visual rhythm. A static image cannot measure real motion speed or uniquely specify BPM.
Propose up to two aesthetic or emotional interpretations with evidence IDs and an alternative reading. Do not default every image to calmness.
Suggest possible mood, tempo/rhythm, texture and spatiality controls, linked to evidence and interpretation. Instrument and mode choices may remain unknown; they are never measured from the image.
Separate image-specific suggestions from generic Chinese-style conventions. Remove unsupported defaults, retain multiple acceptable interpretations and unknowns.
Consider one local counterfactual visual change: which music suggestions could change and which could remain? This is a reasoning diagnostic, not a generation result.
Return the final evidence-linked semantic record and a 30-80 word English instrumental-music prompt using the required JSON format. Preserve uncertainty and do not add measured scores.
single_call: same topics supplied together; output-token caps matched, actual input/output costs not matched
